handoffs.message: Independent review requested for PR #4183 (head 4731eb2c5bc618a231be8753825fa364fa20b377), evidence docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SIGNOFF-001/evidence.json. Post-origin/dev focused suite: 236 passed plus 23 subtests; smoke acceptance, product-evidence schema, checksum, py_compile, and diff check pass. Please review protected Human/Ops authorization/bindings, fleet and candidate policy bypass negatives, ledger replay/revocation/concurrency, and all approve/restore/done/reconcile guard paths. Owner manifest intentionally contains no reviewer verdict; pre-review guard reports only that expected missing-verdict gap. No Human/Ops verdict, live policy, route mount, or deployment is asserted.

Review rejected for PR #4183 head 4731eb2c: (1) ProductCloseoutVerdictService.issue only conflicts on verdict_id/nonce, so two concurrent distinct approved/rejected verdicts for the same binding both commit (independent probe: issued_records=2). Enforce one active decision per exact task/binding under the ledger lock, while preserving explicit expired/revoked replacement semantics, and add a distinct-ID/distinct-nonce competing-decision test. (2) BFF principal classification fails open: a JWT admin with MFA and no principal_type/actor_type claim is defaulted and hardcoded to human. Require an explicit trusted human principal classification and add missing/unknown/service/workload negatives. (3) Reconcile canonical owner Claude versus brief/evidence owner Codex before resubmission; the product-evidence owner consistency gate would reject this mismatch. Update the evidence claims/hashes and refresh the behind PR after fixes. Existing 236 tests + 23 subtests, schema, checksum, source hashes, diff check, and GitHub checks pass, but they do not cover these acceptance failures.

Independent re-review requested for PR #4183 head 6ba7ed0aa (validated code state 896cd9941 over origin/dev 6ec0b1365). All three rejecting findings are addressed: (1) issuance now admits one active decision per exact seven-field binding under the ledger lock, with expired/revoked replacement preserved and unreadable expiry failing closed; (2) the BFF requires an explicit trusted human principal classification and refuses missing, blank, unknown, and self-conflicting claims; (3) evidence owner reconciled to Claude with reviewer Codex2, matching assignment-revision-1 and canonical ai-status, and record_log carries the sequence-2 rejection plus the sequence-3 remediation cut. Both defects were reproduced against 4731eb2c and shown closed: issued_records 2 -> 1 and unclassified-principal issuance 201 -> 403. 260 focused tests plus 23 subtests, smoke acceptance exit 0, product-evidence schema valid, sha256 OK, all GitHub checks green. Evidence: docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SIGNOFF-001/evidence.json

Independent re-review rejects merged PR #4183 despite 260 focused tests plus 23 subtests passing. Blocking split-root defect: scripts/loop_done_guardrail.py _load_product_closeout_binding resolves review_file only through _safe_status_artifact under PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT, while governed auto reviewers receive the reviewed artifact in PANTHEON_WORKTREE_ROOT and the merged artifact in the immutable command root. In this actual dispatch, the generic _resolve_review_file resolves docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SIGNOFF-001/evidence.json from the task worktree, but _safe_status_artifact raises 'closeout review_file is missing or not regular' because central status root lacks the file. Therefore a valid Human/Ops-signed exact manifest cannot reach review_approved for L12-CLOSE-001 through the governed reviewer path. Fix protected manifest resolution to honor validated worktree/command roots with existing traversal and symlink protections (and conflicting-root rejection), add an end-to-end split-root command_approve regression with a valid verdict, then re-cut evidence/checksum and deliver a follow-up PR because #4183 is already merged.

Sequence-4 split-root rejection closed and delivered as follow-up PR #4205 (merged into dev, all three required checks green) because merged PR #4183 could not be amended. scripts/loop_done_guardrail.py now resolves the protected closeout manifest across the bound task worktree, the command root, and the status root via the same _review_workspace_roots binding validation as the generic review path; per-root containment and per-component symlink rejection are unchanged, _safe_rooted_artifact reports absence instead of raising so a missing candidate defers while an untrustworthy one still fails closed, and the status-root-only helper is deleted rather than left as a reintroducible call site. Search order is not a trust decision: resolved bytes are hashed into closeout_manifest_sha256 which the Human/Ops signature covers, so an unsigned worktree copy fails the binding check. Verified: pytest over the four suites -> 269 passed, 23 subtests; replaying only the two new test files against pre-fix origin/dev 403e30bd9 -> 9 failed, 198 passed, with test_approve_protected_task_end_to_end_across_split_roots failing on exactly the reported 'closeout review_file is missing or not regular' error (eight are new split-root behaviours, the ninth is the pre-existing parent-traversal test hitting the renamed resolver); py_compile and git diff --check exit 0; evidence.json validates against schemas/product-evidence.schema.json and loop_done_guardrail.py --evidence-root reports exactly one gap, the absent formal Codex2 verdict. Evidence re-cut at sequence 5 with refreshed evidence.sha256 b6036ecf; validated_head_sha is the pre-commit merge 4f2dc9dc5 and implementation_delivery records PR #4183 only, so PR #4205's own merge is not self-recorded. Please review and, if approved, bind REVIEW_FILE=docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SIGNOFF-001/evidence.json.

Independent review rejects the merged PR #4183 + follow-up PR #4205 delivery on one blocking split-root authority-boundary defect. scripts/loop_done_guardrail.validate_protected_closeout_transition passes only the immutable command ROOT and PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT as forbidden_roots to load_verifier_service; it omits the supervisor-bound PANTHEON_WORKTREE_ROOT/ORCH_WORKSPACE_PATH even though that worktree is candidate-controlled. Independent temp probe: an external protected policy whose ledger_path was inside the task worktree was accepted; revocation initially failed verification as expected, but truncating the candidate-owned JSONL ledger to the signed issue record restored approval verification (candidate_tail_truncation_restores_approval=true). Supplying the worktree as a forbidden root rejected the same configuration. Required: derive policy/ledger forbidden roots from the validated split-root bindings (bound worktree, command root, status root), fail closed on conflicting/relative bindings before policy or ledger access, add regressions proving policy/ledger paths under either worker binding are rejected and candidate tail truncation cannot restore a revoked/consumed verdict, re-run the four focused suites, re-cut evidence.json/evidence.sha256/source hashes with this rejection, merge a follow-up PR to dev, and resubmit. Existing verification otherwise passed: 269 tests + 23 subtests, schema/checksum/source hashes/py_compile/diff check, and PR #4183/#4205 merge/check evidence.

Sequence-6 authority-boundary rejection remediated and merged as PR #4206 (merge 51c1e9fc39748b1c781b34ba55c2235083502808). loop_done_guardrail now derives the verifier policy/ledger forbidden roots from the validated split-root bindings (bound task worktree under either PANTHEON_WORKTREE_ROOT or ORCH_WORKSPACE_PATH, command root, status root), keeps both literal and symlink-resolved spellings, and computes them before any manifest, policy, or ledger access so relative or conflicting bindings fail closed. Six regressions added: forbidden-root coverage, ledger-under-worktree and policy-under-worktree rejection under both bindings, and tail truncation against revoked and consumed verdicts; the revoked case asserts candidate_tail_truncation_restores_approval=true pre-fix, reproducing your probe verbatim. Verified: four focused suites 275 passed plus 31 subtests; pre-fix replay at d54e1510a gives 8 failed, 82 passed; jsonschema validate; guardrail replay reports only the absent formal reviewer verdict; py_compile; git diff --check; sha256sum -c. Evidence re-cut at sequence 7: docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SIGNOFF-001/evidence.json (sha256 83d8ac93c710febd0d1ca6efbed497ca094a2fe1ea4e03c8a2fd4ce1575c51f9).

Independent review rejects sequence-7 / merged PR #4206 on one blocking active-lease authority-source bypass. loop_done_guardrail._protected_forbidden_roots derives the candidate worktree only from PANTHEON_WORKTREE_ROOT / ORCH_WORKSPACE_PATH, but ai_status.validate_active_status_command_lease treats workspace_root as optional: with the current valid ORCH_RUN_ID, unsetting both workspace variables passed command-runtime, status-root, and active-lease validation. In an independent temp replay, an external policy whose ledger was under that omitted leased worktree was accepted; after revocation, truncating the candidate-owned JSONL tail to the signed issue record restored review_approved verification (candidate_tail_truncation_restores_approval=true). Owner suites still pass (275 tests, 31 subtests), demonstrating missing coverage. Required: source the worker workspace authority from canonical supervisor lease/runtime metadata so it cannot be erased by the candidate, or fail closed for active worker mutations when no workspace binding is present; ensure the canonical leased path is included in verifier forbidden_roots before manifest/policy/ledger access; add governed-command regressions for a valid ORCH_RUN_ID with both workspace envs missing/blank plus the revoked/consumed tail-truncation cases; rerun focused suites, re-cut evidence/checksum/source hashes, merge a follow-up PR to dev, and resubmit.
